texts.facts: The appeal is filed against the order dated 04.04.2024 in I.A.No.1 of 2023 in O.S.No.64 of 2023 of the Sub Court, Perumbavoor. The suit is filed under Section 92 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908. Along with the suit, the plaintiffs have filed an application for temporary injunction restraining the 2 nd appellant herein from acting as President of the 1 st appellant Trust and presiding over the meeting of the Board of Directors, Executive Committee or Board of Trustees, till the disposal of the suit. 2. According to the plaintiffs, they are life Trustees of the 1st appellant Trust namely, Sree Narayana Gurukulam Charitable Trust established in the year 2001. They 2024:KER:64053 FAO NO. 55 OF 2024 contended that the Trust is a public Trust represented by its Secretary as per the bye-law. The bye-law provides for three types of Trustees namely, the Life Trustee, the Individual Trustee and the institution Trustee. The relevant clause in the bye-laws dealing with the Board of Trustees, reads as follows: Sree Narayana .Gurukulam Charitable ... vs Murukan Thonaril on 21 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43842129/ 2 "6. BOARD OF TRUSTEES The overall administration, management and control of the affairs of the Trust and its properties shall vest in a Board of Trustees. An individual who contributes or a Corporate body which contributes Rs.5 lakhs (Rupees five lakhs) shall be a LIFE TRUSTEE and such Trustees shall be the Members of the Board of Directors. The Corporate Body will be represented by its President or by its Chief Executive. (as amended on 14.11.2004) 2. INDIVIDUAL TRUSTEE After superseding the Kunnathunadu SNDP Union, The General Secretary of the Yogam has appointed an Executive Committee for managing the affairs of the Kunnathunadu SNDP Union. The 2nd appellant is the Sree Narayana .Gurukulam Charitable ... vs Murukan Thonaril on 21 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43842129/ 3 Chairman of the Administrative Committee so appointed.
texts.arguments: There shall be constituted in the following manner: 1* LIFE TRUSTEE An Individual who contributes or a Corporate Body 2024:KER:64053 FAO NO. 55 OF 2024 which contributes Rs. 1 lakh shall be an Individual Trustee. The Corporate Body shall be represented by its President or by its Chief Executive. 3. INSTITUTIONAL TRUSTEE An individual who contributes or a Corporate Body which contributes Rs.25000 shall be an institutional trustee. The representative of the Corporate Body shall be its President or its Chief Executive. One fourth of the Institutional Trustees shall be represented in the Board of Trustees. The Trustee shall be a member of S.N.D.P. Yogam. In the event of death or insolvency of a Trustee his legal heir shall be nominated as the Trustee. Among the successors only one person will be entitled, with the approval of the Board of Directors, to be a Trustee. The application for Trusteeship shall be in the form as shown in the Annexure." 3. As per clause 9(a) dealing with Executive Committee it is stated that the Committee shall consist of 11 2024:KER:64053 FAO NO. 55 OF 2024 members viz. President, Vice President, Secretary, Joint Secretary, Treasurer and six committee members . It is stated that the President of the Kunnathunadu SNDP Union shall be the ex-officio President of the Committee and the Vice President, Secretary, Joint Secretary, Treasurer and six committee members are to be elected from among the Board of Directors. As per Clause 11, the President is to preside over the meetings of the Board of Directors, Executive Committee and the Board of Directors and regarding matters on which there is a difference of opinion, it shall be decided by majority votes and the President shall have a second or a casting vote in case of a tie. Clause 11 further says that in the absence of the President, the Vice President shall exercise all powers vested with the President. 2024 :KER:64053 FAO NO. 55 OF 2024 Clause 28 empowers the Yogam to stop the functioning of a Union or to cancel the appointment of any officers or committee members of the Union and to conduct fresh election for filling up such vacancies and to appoint necessary officers in the interregnum for managing the affairs of the temple, bhajanamadam, school etc. The counsel for the appellants says that the Administrative Committee and its Chairman are only successors-in-interest of the Board of Management of the Kunnathunadu SNDP Union 2024:KER:64053 FAO NO. 55 OF 2024 and being successors-in-interest the 2nd appellant is entitled to do all functions that the President of the Union is entitled to. The counsel for the appellants relied on the decision of a Division Bench of this Court in Manager, St.Mary's H.S. v. Beji Abraham [2002 KHC 88] to submit that the de facto doctrine saves those acts de facto performed by officers within the scope of their assumed official authority. Reliance is also placed on the judgment of the High Court of Bombay in Rehman and Ors. Vs. The Corporation of the City of Nagpur and Ors.[AIR 1970 Bom 394] and the judgment of Madras High Court in In Re: Palanisamy Chettiar [AIR 1957 Mad 351]. In Rehman and Ors.(supra) the question involved was whether the Administrator appointed on supersession of the Nagpur Corporation can be 2024:KER:64053 FAO NO. 55 OF 2024 treated as the "local authority" under Section 2(viii) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954. The High Court after considering the statutory provisions held that the Administrator would be the successor to the superseded Corporation. The court relied on the provisions contained in Section 409(2) of the City of Nagpur Corporation Act, Sree Narayana .Gurukulam Charitable ... vs Murukan Thonaril on 21 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43842129/ 4 1948 which specifically provided for such a power in the Administrator. In Palanisamy Chettiar (Supra) the Madras High Court was considering the appointment of District Magistrates as Assistant Sessions Judges.
